Vintage Swan Magazine Rack Attributed to Maison Jansen, c. 1960s–1970s

A vintage swan-shaped magazine rack in brass-toned metal, probably dating from the 1960s or 1970s and attributed to Maison Jansen. Its graceful swan form, open wire construction and warm aged finish combine practical storage with sculptural elegance.

The piece

This vintage magazine rack transforms an everyday household object into an elegant sculptural form.

Modelled as a swan, the piece combines a naturalistic cast head, curved neck and webbed feet with an open wire body designed to hold magazines and newspapers. The airy construction gives it a light visual presence despite its generous proportions.

Closely comparable examples are attributed to Maison Jansen, the influential Parisian decorating house known for combining traditional forms with theatrical and refined decorative details. This example bears no visible maker’s mark, so the attribution is based on its design and its close correspondence with documented and commercially catalogued examples.

The brass-toned metal surface has developed a warm, aged finish that emphasises the modelling of the bird and the sweeping lines of the magazine compartment.

Where it works best

Perfect beside an armchair, sofa or reading corner for storing magazines and newspapers.

Its open sculptural form also lends itself to alternative uses. It can hold neatly folded hand towels in a bathroom, small throws beside a sofa or guest bed, or lightweight folders and publications in a study or boutique.

Whether used for practical storage or displayed empty, it remains a striking decorative piece in its own right.

Technical details

Type: Magazine rack

Date:  c. 1960s–1970s

Attribution: Attributed to Maison Jansen

Maker’s mark: No visible maker’s mark

Material: Brass-toned metal

Finish: Warm aged metallic finish

Design: Swan with open wire magazine compartment

Dimensions: 67 × 33 × 39,5 cm (26,4 × 13 × 15.6 in)

Condition

Good vintage condition, with light signs of age and use consistent with its period.

The brass-toned finish displays a gentle aged patina together with minor surface wear that enhances the character of the piece. The structure remains stable and fully functional for everyday use.

Please examine all photographs carefully, as they form an integral part of the description.

Decorative accessories shown in the photographs are for display purposes only and are not included in the sale.

An elegant vintage piece that combines sculptural design with everyday practicality, bringing timeless character to both classic and contemporary interiors.

Vintage Rocket-Inspired Tripod Table Lamp | CiRcA

A slender vintage table lamp with a rocket-like silhouette, formed by an elongated opal plastic body above three splayed black-finished metal legs. When illuminated, its translucent moulded form becomes a softly glowing vertical column.

Description

The lamp’s white body rises through a compact cylindrical centre into a long, tapered upper section. Below, three fine black legs spread out like a graphic launch structure, giving the piece its distinctive upward-reaching profile.

This formal resemblance to a rocket is a visual reading of the design rather than a documented model name. Lit or unlit, the contrast between the luminous white body and the dark tripod base gives the lamp a clear Space Age presence.

Design Maker History

The design relies on the contrast between a lightweight tripod structure and a vertically extended translucent form.

The Piece

·       Type: table lamp

·       Materials: opal moulded plastic and black-finished metal

·       Colour: ivory-white and black

·       Structure: three splayed metal legs

Condition

Vintage condition with light surface marks and age-related tonal variation to the plastic. The black-finished legs show signs of use. The lamp is shown illuminated in the photographs.

Measurements

·       Width: 11 cm / 4.3 in

·       Height: 29 cm / 11.4 in

·       Depth: 11 cm / 4.3 in

Electrical Information

European electrical standard.

Vintage Mid-Century Modern Table Lamp in White and Orange

A striking vintage table lamp with a sculptural silhouette, combining crisp geometric forms with a bold white and orange colour palette.

Its clean lines and balanced proportions make it a fine example of Mid-Century Modern lighting, with subtle Space Age influences that remain timeless today.

Description

The lamp is composed of a broad, gently tapered shade in white and vivid orange, supported by a slender pedestal rising from a circular base.

Its design is defined by simple geometry rather than ornament, allowing the strong colour contrast and elegant proportions to become the main decorative features.

When illuminated, the white diffuser softens the light, while the orange section creates a warm visual glow that enhances the lamp's sculptural character.

The piece

This lamp reflects the optimism and experimentation that characterised much of the best European domestic lighting of the late mid-century period.

Rather than relying on decorative details, it achieves its visual impact through proportion, colour and form. The result is a design that remains remarkably contemporary decades after it was produced.

Where it works best

An ideal choice for a sideboard, console table, bedside cabinet or reading corner.

It works particularly well in Mid-Century Modern interiors but also complements contemporary spaces where a single statement piece introduces colour and sculptural interest.

Technical details

Type: Table lamp

Style: Mid-Century Modern

Design influences: Space Age

Colours: White and orange

Dimensions:

Width: 42 cm / 16.54 in

Depth: 42 cm / 16.54 in

Height: 27 cm / 10.63 in

Electrical information

The lamp is fitted with European wiring and plug.

Condition

Consistent with an authentic vintage piece.

Please examine all photographs carefully, as they form an integral part of the description.

A bold Mid-Century Modern lamp whose sculptural form and vibrant colour continue to feel as fresh today as when it was first designed.

Vintage Brass and Smoked Metal Umbrella Stand, Circa 1970

Description

This vintage umbrella stand is a functional domestic object designed for the storage of walking sticks and umbrellas in entrance halls and reception spaces. Dating to approximately the 1970s, it reflects the decorative vocabulary associated with Hollywood Regency and late twentieth-century eclectic interiors.

Its sculptural presence and combination of materials situate it within a period when utilitarian objects were conceived not only for use but also as ornamental accents within the home. The piece retains its original structure and character.

Design and craftsmanship

The stand is constructed in brass and metal, with a faceted body finished in a smoked tone. The polygonal form is articulated by a brass framework, culminating in a decorative handle and spherical finials.

The base is structured and stable, designed to support the vertical storage of umbrellas. Surface patina, minor wear and tonal variation are consistent with age and use, contributing to its authentic appearance.

Origin & period

Period: circa 1970

Style: Hollywood Regency

Materials: Brass and metal

Origin: Spain

Dimensions

Height: 80 cm (31.5 in)

Diameter / Width: 40 cm (15.7 in)

Condition

Very good vintage condition.

Light surface wear and patina consistent with age and domestic use.

Please refer to the photographs, which form an integral part of the condition report.

Use and display

Originally intended for use in entrance halls, the umbrella stand remains fully functional. It is suitable for period interiors, mid- to late-twentieth-century settings, and curated eclectic spaces where sculptural metalwork forms part of the decorative composition.

A distinctive vintage piece combining functional purpose with ornamental presence.

Vintage Spanish Sunburst Ceiling or Wall Light, c. 1950s–1960s

A striking vintage Spanish sunburst light from the 1950s–1960s, designed for use as either a ceiling or wall fixture.

Its sculptural hammered metal frame and large white opal globe bulb combine atmospheric lighting with timeless mid-century style.

Description

The piece

This striking vintage light celebrates one of the most enduring decorative motifs of the mid-twentieth century: the sunburst.

Radiating wavy metal rays surround a richly textured hammered centre, finished in a softly aged champagne-toned metal that gives the piece warmth without excessive shine. At its heart, a large white opal globe bulb diffuses the light beautifully while preserving the clean sculptural lines of the design.

Among the hammered details, the metalwork subtly recalls the traditional sun-with-a-face motif found in European decorative arts. The softly modelled forms gently suggest facial features without becoming overtly figurative, revealing an unexpected sense of expression the longer the piece is observed.

Suitable for installation on either a ceiling or a wall, it functions equally well as a light fitting and as a sculptural decorative object.

Where it works best

Ideal as a statement light in a living room, entrance hall, dining room, bedroom or covered outdoor space.

Its sculptural silhouette complements Mid-Century Modern, Hollywood Regency, Mediterranean and eclectic interiors, where it serves equally as lighting and architectural decoration.

Technical details

Type: Ceiling or wall light

Origin: Spain

Date: Probably c. 1950s–1960s

Style: Mid-Century Modern / Sunburst

Materials: Hammered metal with an aged champagne-toned finish

Bulb: Large white opal globe bulb (included)

Installation: Suitable for ceiling or wall mounting

Electrical details: Fitted to European electrical standards.

Dimensions:

·       Approx. 55 cm high × 55 cm wide × 22 cm deep

·       (21.7 × 21.7 × 8.7 in)

Condition

Good vintage condition, with signs of age and use consistent with its period.

The hammered metal finish displays gentle wear, minor tarnishing and natural variations in tone acquired over time, all of which contribute to its authentic vintage character. The fitting has been tested and is in working order at the time of listing.

Please examine all photographs carefully, as they form an integral part of the description.

The large white opal globe bulb shown in the photographs is included in the sale.

A beautifully sculptural sunburst light that combines atmospheric illumination with timeless mid-century character, creating an elegant focal point whether displayed on the ceiling or the wall.

Pair of Scandinavian-Style Table Lamps, 1960s–70s, Opaline Glass

Mid-century pair of table lamps with hemispherical opaline glass shades and minimalist Scandinavian design.

Sold as a matching pair.

The piece

This matching pair of table lamps features a clean hemispherical design strongly associated with Scandinavian and Nordic lighting from the mid-20th century. The opaline white glass shades provide a soft, even diffusion of light, reflecting the Scandinavian emphasis on visual comfort and functional simplicity.


The structure and base are made of plastic, and both lamps retain a “patented” marking, indicating an original design manufactured in Spain during the second half of the 20th century.

Lighting & atmosphere

The opaline glass produces a gentle, homogeneous glow, ideal for ambient lighting. These lamps are designed to create a calm and comfortable atmosphere rather than strong directional light.

Where it works best

Designed as table lamps, they are particularly well suited for bedside use, shelving, sideboards, or as auxiliary lighting in living rooms and bedrooms. Their restrained form allows them to integrate easily into Scandinavian, Nordic, or mid-century modern interiors.

Technical details

Installation type: Table lamps (pair)

Quantity: 2 units (matching pair) 

Period: 1960s–1970s 

Origin: Spain 

Material: Plastic 

Glass / diffuser: Opaline glass 

Light points: 2 (one per lamp) 

Dimensions (each):

Width: 19 cm (7.5 in)

Depth: 19 cm (7.5 in) 

Height: 13 cm (5.1 in) 

Voltage: European standard (220–240V) 

Condition: 

Please refer to the photographs, which form an integral part of the condition report.

The lamp works properly and has been tested prior to shipment. The wiring may be original or replaced.
 
A restrained and versatile pair, well suited to interiors that value understated mid-century design.
